nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_constraint
nml_option.description: scale the aerosol so that the column optical depth at 550 nm matches the observations in the aod_obs stream, where there is a valid observation

nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_tropo_only
nml_option.description: scale only the layers below the layer that holds the tropopause, and hold the rest of the column fixed. False scales every layer

nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_interval
nml_option.description: time interval between applications of the AOD constraint

nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_ratio_min
nml_option.description: lower limit of the factor applied to the aerosol

nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_ratio_max
nml_option.description: upper limit of the factor applied to the aerosol

nml_option.name: config_gocart2G_aod_eps
nml_option.description: the aerosol is not scaled where the optical depth of the layers that may be scaled is below this value

var.name: AOD_mean
var.description: observed aerosol optical depth at 550 nm as read from the aod_obs stream; negative where there is no observation

var.name: aod_obs_before
var.description: observation record at or before the current time; negative where there is no observation

var.name: aod_obs_after
var.description: observation record at or after the current time; negative where there is no observation

var.name: observed_aod
var.description: AOD constraint: observed optical depth at 550 nm interpolated to the time of the update; -999 where there is none

var.name: first_guess_aod
var.description: AOD constraint: model column optical depth at 550 nm before the update

var.name: analyzed_aod
var.description: AOD constraint: model column optical depth at 550 nm after the update

var.name: tropospheric_aod
var.description: AOD constraint: first-guess optical depth of the layers that may be scaled

var.name: stratospheric_aod
var.description: AOD constraint: first-guess optical depth of the layers held fixed

var.name: aod_scale_factor
var.description: AOD constraint: factor applied to the aerosol; 1 where there was no update

var.name: aod_update_applied
var.description: AOD constraint: 1 where the aerosol was scaled toward an observation, 0 elsewhere

var.name: aod_clamped_low
var.description: AOD constraint: 1 where the factor was held at its lower limit

var.name: aod_clamped_high
var.description: AOD constraint: 1 where the factor was held at its upper limit

var.name: aod_below_stratosphere
var.description: AOD constraint: 1 where the observation was smaller than the optical depth held fixed

var.name: aod_tropopause_pressure
var.description: AOD constraint: tropopause pressure used to separate the layers; 0 where no layer holds it
